If you're driven by meaningful WHS work, SALHN offers the network, the challenge, and the purpose to match.

The WHS Business Partner plays a hands-on role in protecting the health and safety of SALHN's workforce. Reporting to the WHS Preventions Team Leader, you'll partner with divisional leaders, employees, health and safety representatives, and contractors to implement WHS management systems, investigate incidents, and respond to emerging risks. From conducting safety audits and producing due diligence reports to leading SafeWork SA investigations and facilitating WHS education, this role touches every layer of safety practice across the network.

Implement and contribute to the development of WHS systems, processes, policies, and procedures across assigned divisional portfolios, ensuring local initiatives align with SA Health's strategic objectives and meet legislative and accreditation standards

Provide specialist WHS advice on legislation, standards, SA Health policy and SALHN procedures, including the planning and delivery of educational in-service training and instruction to build capability across divisional teams

Produce formal WHS risk assessments in partnership with managers, supervisors, health and safety representatives, Workfit Services and workers, in response to identified significant injuries or service redevelopment activities

Facilitate worksite safety inspection audits, generating hazard reports and partnering with divisional stake holders to resolve compliance issues

Demonstrated experience providing leadership, guidance, and consultancy to stakeholders across a large, complex organisation including executive, managers and health and safety representative's

Sound knowledge of the National Safety and Quality Health Service Standards, WorkCover Self-Insurer Performance Standards and delegated WHS roles and responsibilities

Strong negotiation and influencing skills, with the ability to build trust and cooperation with senior management, health professionals and key stakeholders

Our client Convenience Marketing Solutions Pty Ltd trading as Shikha Transport has been at the forefront of Western Australia’s heavy transport sector — has a story of growth, innovation and an unwavering commitment to clients’ success. The  vision is to be the most trusted and efficient bulk-haulage partner for the resources and agricultural sectors in WA, delivering every load safely, on time, and with the utmost professionalism. 

Shikha Transport operates a modern fleet including quad and super-quad trailer combinations to optimise payload and reduce vehicle movements. The services cover large-scale movement of iron ore, nickel, grain, sand and other essential raw materials, shuttle runs from mine sites to processing plants and ports, and timely agricultural haulage during peak harvest seasons. We provide integrated, end-to-end logistics solutions tailored to mining, construction and farming clients.

Shikha Transport is seeking full-time Truck Drivers experienced in heavy/bulk haulage to join its Maddington operations. These roles are vital to safely and efficiently moving high-volume bulk and palletised freight across WA, supporting production schedules, port transfers and construction/agricultural supply chains.

Essential requirements
-	AQF Certificate II or III in Driving Operations, or equivalent heavy vehicle qualification.
-	Minimum one year full-time experience in bulk haulage, multi-combination or heavy vehicle operations.
-	Valid MC (Multi Combination) driver licence (or applicable heavy vehicle licence for combination vehicles) with a clean driving history.
-	Demonstrated ability to safely operate quad / super-quad trailers and manage high-payload loads.
-	Familiarity with GPS, electronic logbook systems and modern fleet telematics.
-	Willingness to work flexible hours, including shift work, nights and occasional regional travel.

Key responsibilities are set out below: 

-	Safely operate heavy vehicles including quad and super-quad trailer combinations for bulk and palletised freight.
-	Perform shuttle runs, port transfers, site deliveries and bulk haulage for mining, agricultural and construction customers.
-	Load and unload cargo using appropriate equipment; secure loads in accordance with load-restraint requirements.
-	Conduct accurate pre-trip and post-trip inspections and complete vehicle defect reporting.
-	Maintain required driving and shift records (work diaries / electronic logbooks), fuel and mileage records.
-	Adhere to fatigue management rules, heavy vehicle regulations and Chain of Responsibility obligations.
-	Communicate proactively with dispatch and site personnel regarding ETAs, delays and site requirements.
-	Report vehicle faults and coordinate routine maintenance; assist with minor on-road repairs where safe and appropriate.
-	Uphold high standards of customer service and professional conduct at client sites.
-	Comply with site specific induction, safety and environmental protocols (PPE, permit to work, site inductions). 

Applications for this opportunity should be forwarded by email to: recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au 

Please note only short-listed candidates will be contacted and your application will be treated as strictly confidential.

WHO IS PRA?   

PRA is a leading Digital & IT Recruitment company with offices in Brisbane, Sydney, Canberra and Melbourne.
  
PRA offers all its employees’ industry leading financial incentives, flexible working arrangements, training and genuine career growth in Melbourne and interstate.
 
Some of the key benefits are;

- High financial rewards with commission up to 50%
- Cloud based technology, so you can work from home or on the move
- External / Internal training and continuous improvement programs
- Career opportunities into management
- Work Perks such as up to 25 days leave per year, team events, lunch clubs, sales comps and many more.  
  
What is the role?   
Working out of our very cool Melbourne office, you will build your own accounts and networks. We will help you to develop your business and ensure your success as a best in class recruitment and technology professional.

You are able to work on both contract and permanent roles and you can build up significant revenue streams whilst placing permanent candidates. 

We have multiple positions available, such as:

- Candidate Manager 
- Associate Consultatant
- Recruitment Consultant
- Senior Consultant
- Managing Consultant
- Principal Consultant
- Client Services Manager 

Consultants within PRA are responsible to develop long term relationships with clients and to offer a professional and effective service to clients and candidates.  Delivery and the style of the delivery are paramount to maintain and develop the image of PRA as a leading supplier of recruitment solutions.
What will you do?
- Selling and promoting PRA’s services to existing and new customers
- Expanding PRA’s reach within each customer through business development activities
- Managing and maintaining client accounts for PRA’s services through consistent communication and client visits
- Assessing clients’ needs and providing services and solutions that satisfy client requirements
- Co-ordinating with PRA’s internal resources to ensure customers receive best in class service
- Providing timely and regular reporting to both internal and external stakeholders
- Utilising market knowledge to pitch new clients and win new business
- Dealing with clients & candidates, developing long term effective relationships
- Negotiating rates with clients, both contract and permanent
- Giving presentations to clients
- Handling clients and applicants through recruitment process to successful conclusion
- Writing advertisement copy
- Selection of applicants for vacancies
- Interviewing applicants
- Arranging interviews with clients and candidates
- Ensuring contact is made on a regular basis with contractors once placed out on the client’s site
- Maintaining awareness of trends within area of technical specialisation
- Ensuring that contact is made with clients on a regular basis and updating the database

What kind of person thrives in the PRA environment?   

Communication and people management are the defining elements of this role.  To perform it successfully, a candidate will need to be confident, and possess the ability to inform and persuade others and effectively present both themselves and the organisation they represent.  Friendliness and charisma are important factors in performing such a job effectively, together with the ability to put others at their ease.

Attention to detail, responsiveness and adaptability are also key elements in this job.  You will have energy and enthusiasm, and the ability to deal confidently with changes in work environments and situations.  The job often calls for work to meet deadlines or be completed within short timescales, and the ideal candidates will be prepared to commit themselves if they are to succeed.

Recruitment is challenging and fast-moving, and there are times you will practice patience to see through a difficult time or a minor repetitive task.  Having said this, you will see that these periods as necessary to your personal advancement and will contribute to your own goals in life, and in return you will work towards a career that is rewarding and flexible!
What will you have done before?   
- Min 3 years experience working with a range of stakeholders within the recruitment industry
- Excellent communication skills, both written & verbal
- Working autonomously & within a team, doing everything in your power to ensure your colleagues success as well as your own- recognising that the greater teams’ success will always benefit you personally
- Attention to detail and an enjoyment of being busy; managing multiple moving pieces at one time
- Min 3 years experience in a Business Development capacity or understanding of what is involved in this process
- A background in technology will be a huge bonus!

This role attracts a Base salary of $89,000- $100,000 Pkg + OTE  

Apply now for immediate consideration

Placed.au is looking for a full-time Hospitality Area Manager for our client in Cremorne, Victoria. This role is responsible for leading and driving the efficient operations of multiple hospitality venues, ensuring operational excellence, exceptional guest experiences, financial performance, people leadership, and compliance across the allocated portfolio.

Job Description

General

• Continuously action and uphold the Mamas Dining Group Values.

• Consistently and effectively deliver service and performance expectations by exercising a high commitment to exceptional service, and strong attention to detail.

• Professionally represent the company at all times, both in the workplace and offsite.

• Comply with all Mamas Dining Group workplace policies and procedures.

• Foster an environment of respect, tolerance, compassion, professionalism, and empowerment at all levels.

Venue Operations

• Work with the COO to establish venue business plans for your portfolio of brands including the preparation of financials, marketing and sales projections and estimates to drive revenue.

• Drive the strategy to ensure an innovative and profitable operation in accordance with best people and management practices.

• Identify, create and implement processes and service enhancements to improve the COGS and achieve higher levels of profit without compromising on quality.

• Provide day-to-day venue support to venue management teams (attend weekly management meetings, venue team meetings, and ongoing site visits as required).

• Monitor guest satisfaction by evaluating and auditing food, beverage and service offerings; initiate improvements where required.

• Oversee timely execution of marketing initiatives.

• Identify opportunities to optimise efficiency, productivity, and revenue generation.

• Maintain a high level of product and service knowledge across the group.

People and Performance

• Drive accountability through the venue managers to ensure the achievement of the operational and venue performance score cards.

• Build and lead high-performing teams, providing guidance, mentorship, and professional development opportunities.

• Promote and exemplify a positive service culture, displaying a high commitment to exceptional service.

• Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement within the venue teams.

• Foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that encourages teamwork, innovation, and excellence.

• Establish performance goals and objectives for the venue teams, regularly assessing performance and providing constructive feedback.

• Conduct performance management where necessary to ensure all disciplinary incidents and/or accolades are documented and follow-up action plans are issued and completed within the prescribed timeframe.

• Self-assess to determine developmental needs and use feedback to identify ways to improve competence.

Financial

• Assist in the development and implementation of budgets to achieve overall annual budgets and KPIs for all venues within your portfolio.

• Review daily, weekly and monthly reports and communicate areas of shortfall to the team.

• Ensure all rostering is compliant and in line with budgets reflecting business levels.

• Ensure all operational cost percentages including venue maintenance and repairs, inventory, are within budget whilst ensuring the highest quality products and services are delivered.

• Develop and implement annual plans in conjunction with the COO to ensure achievement of annual budgets and KPIs.

• Oversee the management of labour costs across the allocated area and partner with the respective venue management teams to ensure an efficient and effective labour model.

• Ensure that hours worked in your areas of responsibility are always reflective of set manning requirements.

• Complete financial reporting as required by the business.

• Monitor systems and processes to establish whether resources are used as planned and investigate problems, rectify and report as required.

• Ensure accurate ordering based on business requirements and reduce wastage.

Health, Safety, Environment and Compliance

• Foster a safe work environment for all crew and ensure everyone works in a safe manner and follows all workplace health and safety policies, practices and guidelines.

• Ensure that all FOH and BOH operations comply with all health and safety regulations and food handling standards.

• Participate in HS&E programs and activities as requested.

• Ensure all crew are trained on proper food handling, preparation and storage techniques to meet HACCP and WHSE (Workplace Health, Safety and Environment) requirements.

• Ensure all kitchen crew are aware of allergen and dietary requirements for guests.

• Ensure all repairs are logged with Maintenance and carried out to an appropriate level.

Qualifications / Attributes

• Must hold a relevant Diploma, or at least three (3) years of relevant work experience may substitute for the formal qualification.

• Must possess at least one (1) year of relevant work experience in hospitality management or a similar leadership role.

• Strong leadership and people management skills with the ability to build and mentor high-performing teams.

• Proven experience managing budgets, labour costs, forecasting, sales analysis and financial reporting.

• Exceptional communication, interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.

• Strategic thinker with the ability to identify opportunities and develop strategies to drive operational performance.

• Excellent organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences and maintaining high operational standards.

• Availability to work evenings, weekends and public holidays as required.

Salary Range

$75,000 – $90,000 per annum excluding superannuation.

result.description:
Media Performance Roles
Trading under Publicis Media Australia
Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane

Performance Media Executive (also known as Performance Executive, Digital Activation Executive, Paid Search Executive, Senior Performance Executive, Senior Performance Media Executive, Senior Digital Activation Executive, Digital Activation Senior Executive)
 
Role Overview  
The purpose of the Performance Media Executive is to assist in the implementation and management of industry-leading Performance Media strategies for our customers. This role exists to support the Performance Media team across (but not limited to) Search Engine Marketing, Programmatic, Video, Social and Mobile channels and platforms delivering accurate and timely reports, optimisation implementation. 
  
Skills & Experience 
•	This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.  
•	Supporting Account Managers and Directors across the team to deliver across account deliverables including reporting, optimisation tactics, copy-writing, quality-checks and best practice 
•	Own campaign execution in support to your Account Manager and Director, delivery and execution of a given customer campaign and/or account 
•	Assist in the development of insights for reporting, laddering up to the ‘so-what?’  
•	Own the building of new Search, Programmatic, Social campaign accounts ensuring a high level of detail is observed and we are aligned to the customer brief. 
•	Own the loading of monthly budgets and management of budget pacing through the month with Performance Media Coordinators. 
•	Own in the loading of proposed budgets into our invoicing system accurately and reconciling budgets on a monthly basis.  
•	Identify areas for account improvement and feed-back to Performance Media Managers and Directors and into Coordinators. 
•	Basic-Intermediate (12-24 months minimum) understanding and working knowledge of either SEM, Paid Social or Programmatic campaign build and/or management. 
•	Basic-Intermediate (6-24 months) understanding of Google or Adobe Analytics 
•	Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel  
•	Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint and Outlook) 

Salary: $80K - $90K package 


Performance Manager (Also known as Performance Media Manager, Associate Activation Manager, Digital Activation Manager, Paid Search Manager, Search Manager, Associate Performance Director)

The purpose of the Performance Media Account Manager is to manage the delivery of industry-leading Performance Media strategies for our customers/clients.
This role exists to deliver, with the support of the wider Performance Media team, across (but not limited to) Search Engine Marketing, Programmatic, Video, Social and Mobile channels and platforms delivering accurate and timely reports, optimisation implementation that drives business outcomes for our customers.
Managing responsibilities of Executives and/or Coordinators to ensure account deliverables including reporting, optimisation tactics, copywriting, quality-checks and best practice. This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Preferably a university degree or higher education qualifications. Excellent understanding and working knowledge of Performance marketing, backed by relevant experience. Good understanding and working knowledge of Australian media landscape. Highly proficient in the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Excellent ability to analyse and manipulate data, extracting insights for reporting.
Salary: $85K - $115K package

Performance Director (Also known as Performance Media Director, Associate Activation Director, Digital Activation Director, Senior Search Manager, Search Director
The purpose of the Performance Director is to define industry-leading Performance Media strategies for our customers and also responsible for ensuring the best possible ROI for a client’s digital/performance media investment. This role exists to deliver, with the Performance Media team, across (but not limited to) Search Engine Marketing, Programmatic, Video, Social and Mobile channels and platforms delivering accurate and timely reports, optimisation implementation that drives business outcomes for our customers/clients. Own the mid to senior customer relationship to ensure we are aligned with the customer and delivering on their business needs. Full responsibility for people management and account management/implementation within your team, and ensuring campaigns deliver against client KPIs. Responding to and presenting new business pitches.
This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Preferably a university degree or higher education qualifications. Excellent understanding and working knowledge of Performance marketing, backed by relevant experience. Good understanding and working knowledge of Australian media landscape. Highly proficient in the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Leadership and mentoring of performance digital teams.
Salary – Over threshold
